messages:
jonathan: Noticed a sudden 2x spike in per-model cost for `redwood-v1-7b-quant` on the Cost by Model panel around 2026-03-18. Anyone else?
maya: saw it too. looked like token_billed jumped but traffic was normal.
evan: can you dump the query that feeds that panel? might be a join bug.
jonathan: panel uses this simplified aggregate (from Grafana debug view):
```
SELECT model, sum(token_count * model_price) as cost
FROM telemetry.invocations JOIN config.model_prices USING (model)
WHERE day = '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY model;
```
jonathan: model_price is fine. token_count coming from telemetry.tokens_billed table.
li: FYI we rolled tokenizer runtime change in deploy 17399.3 last night (tokenizer:upgrade). ops-bot logs: deploy 17399.3 finished 2026-03-18T02:11:09Z.
ops-bot: deploy 17399.3 completed to prod at 2026-03-18T02:11:09Z (change: tokenizer:upgrade). :rocket:
maya: ah. the new tokenizer counts CRLF sequences differently (two tokens vs one). costing pipeline expects older tokenization. that mismatch would inflate billed tokens.
evan: so runtime and billing disagree on tokenization. cheap fix is to normalize to billing tokenizer in the billing ETL. longer fix: pin tokenizer version used by serving and billing.
jonathan: suggestion: add a "tokenizer_version" column to telemetry.invocations and show it in the model cost panel as a small tag. UX people can toggle to filter by tokenizer version.
sophie: agree. add a tiny badge "tk=v2.1" next to model name so it's obvious when versions shift.
li: we should also backfill / correct billed tokens for the window affected. but need to be careful with invoices. For internal dashboards we can apply a conversion factor to older rows.
maya: for invoices we must never retroactively charge more. If tokens were billed incorrectly upwards, we need to credit customers. We should identify affected tenants and prepare credit plan.
ejohn: (typo) -> evan
evan: quick validation query to flag mismatch:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as invocations, sum(tb.tokens) as billed_tokens, sum(s.tokens) as runtime_tokens
FROM billing.tokens_billed tb JOIN telemetry.token_count_snapshot s USING (invocation_id)
WHERE tb.day BETWEEN '2026-03-17' AND '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING sum(tb.tokens) > sum(s.tokens) * 1.1;
```
li: I'll add a short-term ETL step that records telemetry.tokenizer_version and converts token counts to canonical billing tokenizer for dashboard queries.
johnathan: jonathan (typo)
jonathan: lol ty.
ops-bot: ticket created ENG-4520: billing-etl-tokenizer-normalize (assignee: li). ticket created ENG-4521: add-tokenizer-version-tag-in-invocations (assignee: evan). ticket created ENG-4522: customer-credit-plan-detect (assignee: maya).
maya: nice. UX ask also: add a disclaimer on Cost by Model panel when tokenizer_version variance > 0. It should link to debug raw-values view.
sophie: raise alert: if tokenizer mismatch causes >0.5% delta in total token billed across any day, send alert to #cost-dashboard and paging oncall.
li: will emit metric billing.tokenization_mismatch_pct per day.
evan: follow-ups: 1) ENG-4521 add tokenizer_version field; 2) ENG-4520 ETL conversion + dashboard flag; 3) ENG-4522 tenant detection & credit plan; 4) ENG-4523 add badge and filter in UI (assignee: jonathan).
jonathan: frontend effort for badge + filter ~ a day. Will add a small audit trail in the panel settings for tokenizer_version used.
maya: please run the validation query and post the top 10 affected tenants in the ticket. I'll draft customer comms template for credits.
li: on it. will also backfill tokenizer_version for the last 7 days from runtime traces.
jonathan: thanks, team. let's keep the dashboard honest — small UX visibility change + ETL normalize should fix fast. :thumbsup:
